headline: Kazakhstan crude oil exports to France increase 34% in 9M
summary: Official figures show Kazakhstan exported 5.06 million tonnes of crude oil and bituminous products to France in Jan-Sept 2026, up 33.98% year-on-year.
why: Kazakhstan is a major oil exporter in Central Asia, supplying crude to European refineries via non-Russian supply chains.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Higher oil export volumes generate increased export revenues for Kazakhstan.
